picker.subtitle: Pick a short stretch and drill it. Short beats long.
picker.title: Practice this podcast

dictation.description: Type what you hear, checked word by word
dictation.label: Dictation

loopCrack.description: One short chunk on repeat until you hear every word
loopCrack.label: Loop until you crack it

threePass.description: Blind, then with subtitles, then blind again
threePass.label: Three passes

rail.cycleIdle: Listening — next drill in a few minutes

blind1.body: Don't try to catch every word. Just get the shape of it.
blind1.title: First pass — no subtitles

blind2.body: Same audio. Notice how much more of it lands.
blind2.title: Third pass — no subtitles

dictation.hint: {{replays}} replays so far. Take as many as you need.
dictation.title: Write what you hear

dictationBrief.body: You'll hear a short chunk twice. Write down what you hear — replays are free.
dictationBrief.title: Dictation

dictationCheck.body: Same audio at 0.85x with the text visible.
dictationCheck.title: Hear it again, slower

guided.body: Now read along and find what you missed.
guided.title: Second pass — with subtitles

loop.revealedHint: Now hear it again with the words in front of you.
loop.title: Listen closely

loopBrief.body: A short chunk repeats. Tap when you can hear every word.
loopBrief.title: Loop until you crack it

preteach.body: Twenty seconds to meet the hard ones before you hear them.
preteach.empty: Nothing unusual in this stretch — go straight in.
preteach.title: Words coming up

summary.deltaFlatHint: This one is worth coming back to tomorrow.
summary.keepGoing: Keep going — drill again in {{n}} min
summary.title: Session complete
